## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Created from the mobile simulator audit of MDV-P5-053, findings M-06.

Findings and evidence: docs/product-ux-audit/13-mobile-simulator-audit.md, findings M-06, with screenshots of synthetic cast data in docs/product-ux-audit/evidence/mobile-simulator.
Components affected: the sign-in biometric offer, Account, Profile and Welcome strings in en, hi and ar. No new component.
Prerequisites and blocked by: MDV-P5-053. Not in the pilot flow: the pilot runs on the web app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: real data in the apps (MDV-P5-033) and store builds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given Android, when any screen mentions biometrics, then it never says Face ID
- [ ] **AC2.** Given iOS, when the device has Face ID or Touch ID, then the matching word is used
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the biometric offer after sign-in, when it shows, then it has a Not now that leaves biometrics off

- ui-native or app unit tests for the changed behaviour; a simulator check recorded on the PR with synthetic data only.
